_comment: Volt encoder job config. One file == one channel/event. The control plane renders this per activation and mounts it at /job/config.json (or passes it via JOB_CONFIG_JSON). This example is the RTM packaging workflow with Axinom DRM.
_redundancy_comment: OPTIONAL, chosen at setup. Omit the whole block for no redundancy (the default). input_failover uses the role='backup' inputs below. input_loss_behavior is what the OUTPUT shows when ALL live inputs are down (slate | vod_loop | last_frame | black); we hold there until a live input returns so the output never stalls. There is NO backup output.
_status_report_comment: Where the encoder POSTs its live status snapshot on every change (source up/down, failover, filler). The control plane exposes it to the admin. Token authenticates the container to the ingest endpoint (from Secrets Manager). Omit to only log events to stdout/CloudWatch + the local status file.

_transcode_example._comment: For the transcode workflow instead: workflow=transcode, one mezzanine input, and a ladder array. gpu=true selects NVENC on a g5/g6 node.
